containers.name: reader
command:
import datetime,re
lo=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-22T05:57:30+00:00');hi=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-22T05:59:30+00:00')
n=0
with open('/host-log/syslog',errors='replace') as f:
 for line in f:
  try:t=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(line.split()[0].replace('Z','+00:00'))
  except:continue
  if t.tzinfo is None:continue
  if lo<=t<=hi and re.search(r'edgecore|edged|orphan|volume|kubelet|systemd',line,re.I):
   if re.search(r'token|password|authorization|secret',line,re.I):continue
   print(line.rstrip()[:1800]);n+=1
   if n>=500:print('OUTPUT_LIMIT');break
print('MATCHES',n)
